highlights.title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Explored $1 Trillion Moonshot Buyout of SK Hynix
highlights.description: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible trillion-dollar buyout of memory chip giant SK Hynix, according to people familiar with the matter, though a spokesperson said he’s no longer actively considering such a deal. “SoftBank explores many opportunities, and this one is no longer under active consideration,” said a SoftBank spokesperson.

alsoIn.title: Sources: Masayoshi Son recently explored a possible $1T buyout of SK Hynix; SoftBank says the deal is "no longer under active consideration" (The Information)

highlights.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
highlights.description: On the heels of Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering, a researcher at the company said he believes he used its artificial intelligence software to solve a famous number theory problem that has plagued mathematicians for more than 150 years.

highlights.description: Dario and Daniela Amodei were on top of the biggest IPO ever Thursday–and a market rout one day later. It’s the latest unusual development for a company that is anything but normal.

highlights.title: Nvidia faces further blow after shock US export permit data release: analysts
highlights.description: US lawmakers have thrown the cross-border semiconductor trade into fresh turmoil after releasing confidential licensing records showing Washington approved the sale of nearly 880,000 advanced AI chips to Chinese tech companies earlier this year. The disclosures, made by a US House committee on Thursday, could prompt Chinese buyers to pivot from Nvidia to Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) in the short term and accelerate their transition to home-made chips over the long run, analysts said. The filing.

highlights.description: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is reportedly in talks to buy Zscaler Inc., a publicly traded provider of cybersecurity software. devices.title: WhatsApp increases the group chat limit to 1,500 members
devices.description: WhatsApp has increased the group chat limit from 1,024 to 1,500 members, reports WABetaInfo. With the new limit, admins can now add up to 1,500 members to a group. This increased limit applies not only to group chats, but also to community group chats. The increased limit is available to Android and iOS users, but it is rolling out gradually, so not everyone can add 1,500 members right now.
